description: Create a booking for a company as a guest. Requires a date (YYYY/MM/DD), an hour and shift_id obtained from list-available-slots, and the guest contact details. On success, returns a `token` field: the booking management token to pass to get-booking-info and cancel-booking. When `type` is "Deposit", give the guest the `redirect_url` to pay the deposit, which confirms the booking.

company_id.description: The company id, as returned by the find-company tool.

date.description: Booking date in YYYY/MM/DD format (e.g. 2026/07/20). Note the slashes.

email.description: Guest email address. The booking confirmation and management token are sent here.

gluten_free.description: Whether the party needs gluten-free options.

guest_token.description: Existing guest token, if the guest has booked before.

hour.description: Booking hour in HH:MM format, taken from list-available-slots.

nuts_allergy.description: Whether the party has a nut allergy.

shift_id.description: The shift id, taken from list-available-slots.

vegan.description: Whether the party includes vegan guests.

vegetarian.description: Whether the party includes vegetarian guests.

name: create-booking
title: Create Booking
